metadata.title: Don't Open The Door At 3AM
metadata.subtitle: My upstairs neighbor texted at 2:58 AM: Someone outside your door is wearing your coat.

nodes.text: 2:58 AM · Rain hammers against your 4th-floor window. Your phone buzzes on the nightstand.
Maya, are you awake?! DO NOT open your front door.
Noah? What's going on, it's 3 in the morning...
I just checked the stairwell camera. Someone climbed up to floor 4 wearing your yellow raincoat.
My yellow coat is hanging right next to my door. Stop messing with me.
You glance at the coat rack by your door. The hook is empty. Then three slow knocks echo from the hallway.

nodes.prompt: The doorknob slowly twists. What do you do?

options.label: Stay silent & check the deadbolt
options.player_reply_text: Noah, the lock is holding. Call 911 right now!

options.label: Record through the peephole lens

nodes.text: You press your back against the wall. Outside, the footsteps stop—and a folded note slides under the door.
Police are 6 minutes out. Wait... did the hallway light just go out?
SECRET UNLOCKED: Through your phone's zoomed camera on the peephole, the figure lifts their hood—they're holding YOUR spare apartment key!
Noah, they have my spare key! Only the building manager and YOU have a copy!
Mine is still on my kitchen hook—WAIT. It's gone. My balcony door is wide open!
3:02 AM · Suddenly, the power in your apartment dies—and your phone starts ringing from No Caller ID.

nodes.headline: The Call Is Coming From Inside...
nodes.teaser_text: Episode 2: Your hallway is empty—because the caller's phone is ringing inside your own apartment.

nodes.text: 3:02 AM · Pitch dark. Your phone screen lights up the room.
You whisper 'Hello?'—and hear your OWN voice echo back from the kitchen pantry two seconds later.
You hit Decline. One second later, a muffled busy-signal beeps softly from behind your kitchen pantry door.
Maya!! The hallway cam just came back on—the person in the coat NEVER left Floor 4. Wait... check your fire escape!
Noah, they're NOT in the hallway. Someone is in my kitchen.

nodes.prompt: The pantry latch clicks open. You have 3 seconds!

options.label: Sprint out the front door to Noah
options.player_reply_text: Open your door, Noah! I'm running up the stairs!

options.label: Trigger the building fire alarm
options.player_reply_text: Let's wake the entire building up!

nodes.text: You rip open the deadbolt and sprint into the stairwell. Behind you, your apartment door slams shut.
SECRET UNLOCKED: You smash the hallway fire alarm. Floodlights snap on—and you catch the intruder's face on camera as they bolt down the fire escape: IT'S THE NIGHT SECURITY GUARD!
I got his face on video! It's Carl from the front desk—he's been copying tenant keys!
Red and blue sirens flash outside the building. You reach Apt 5B—but Noah's door is already ajar, and his phone sits on the floor.
Wrong floor, Maya. Noah never lived in 5B.

nodes.headline: Noah Never Lived In 5B...
nodes.teaser_text: Episode 3: You check the building ledger—and realize Apt 5B has been empty for three years.

nodes.text: 3:12 AM · Locked inside your bedroom. Your phone buzzes with a security snapshot from the lobby desk.
Maya, don't listen to the building manager. I moved into 5B last month—he never updated the list!

nodes.caption: Hallway Cam 5F (3:11 AM): The door to Apt 5B is taped shut with police seal. Nobody lives there.

nodes.text: Police tape?! Who the hell have I been texting for six months?!
I only wanted to watch over you after the last tenant in 4B disappeared.
Check your Wi-Fi router, Maya. "Apt 5B" is connected from inside YOUR walls.

nodes.transcript: [static crackling, faint breathing] Don't look at the hallway monitor, Maya. Look at the air vent above your closet.

nodes.text: My coat is hanging in the closet—and the vent screws are lying on the carpet.

nodes.prompt: Something scrapes softly above your ceiling. What do you do?

options.label: Grab your keys and bolt for the stairs
options.player_reply_text: I'm not staying in this room another second!

options.label: Snap a photo of the vent and trigger 911
options.player_reply_text: Photo sent to 911 dispatch with GPS pin—officers are 3 minutes out.

nodes.text: STOP! The stairwell light is out—he's waiting on the fourth-floor landing!
VIP TWIST: Your camera flash reveals a glowing red lens hidden inside the vent—and two pale fingers retreating!
You shouldn't have turned on the flash, Maya. Now we have to meet face to face.
Lock the bathroom door! The hallway camera just went black!

nodes.headline: The Vent Grate Drops...
nodes.teaser_text: Episode 4: A shadow steps into your hallway—and the person calling from No Caller ID reveals their real name.

nodes.text: 3:20 AM · The breaker box clicks off. Your apartment plunges into pitch darkness.
Maya, I'm Detective Morales. The man texting you as "Noah" is the former building super fired in 2023.

nodes.caption: Corridor Cam 4F (3:19 AM): A tall figure in your yellow raincoat stands outside Apt 4B.

nodes.text: He's wearing my raincoat! How did he get a key to my deadbolt?!
I never returned the master key ring when they fired me.
That "detective" is lying to you, Maya. Look through the peephole—nobody is wearing a badge.

nodes.transcript: [sirens faint in distance] Stay quiet! Two patrol units are entering the lobby now. Do NOT let him know you're in the bathroom.

nodes.text: I can hear your phone vibrating behind the tile wall, Maya. Open up.

nodes.prompt: The bathroom doorknob slowly turns. What do you do?

options.label: Wedge the towel bar under the handle
options.player_reply_text: Hold the door—officers, I'm in 4B, he's right outside!

options.label: Play a loud police siren audio on max
options.player_reply_text: Playing dispatch siren through the Bluetooth speaker by the front door!

nodes.text: A towel bar won't hold ten seconds—DAMN IT, are those cops on the stairs?!
VIP TWIST: The speaker blasts sirens from the foyer—he panics and bolts toward the maintenance hatch!
He panicked and bolted—he just dropped a burner phone in your hallway! Can you see the screen?
It's still unlocked... Wait—there's a second apartment pinned on his map!

nodes.headline: Floor Five Blackout...
nodes.teaser_text: Episode 5: His dropped phone reveals a hidden room behind Apt 5B—and another tenant is still trapped inside.

nodes.text: 3:28 AM · Emergency red lights flicker on in the stairwell. You clutch the stalker's dropped phone.
Maya, wait for my officers! Don't go up to the fifth floor alone!

nodes.caption: Dropped Phone GPS: Live tracker blinking inside the sealed crawlspace behind Apt 5B.

nodes.text: There's a girl's voice coming from his live baby monitor app! She's tied up in 5B!
If you touch that crawlspace latch, I'll cut the elevator cables with her inside.
Come up to 5B alone, Maya. Trade your phone for her key.

nodes.transcript: [running footsteps] We're on Floor 3! Keep him talking for sixty seconds—just don't step inside 5B!

nodes.text: I'm at the 5B door. The police tape is sliced cleanly down the middle.

nodes.prompt: He calls your name from the dark doorway. What do you do?

options.label: Stall him from the hallway until cops arrive
options.player_reply_text: Slide her key into the hallway first, Noah—I'm not moving an inch.

options.label: Pull the Floor 5 fire alarm right now
options.player_reply_text: Fire alarm pulled—every door on Floor 5 just opened and the lights are on!

nodes.text: You always were too smart for this building, Maya...
VIP TWIST: Strobe lights blind him in the doorway as neighbors pour out with phones recording!
POLICE! DROP THE KEY RING AND GET ON THE FLOOR!
Wait—he's reaching for the deadbolt inside 5B!

nodes.headline: 3:33 AM — Open The Lock
nodes.teaser_text: Episode 6 (Season Finale): One last lock stands between the hostage and freedom.

nodes.text: 3:33 AM · Red and blue strobes flood the fifth floor. Officers breach Apt 5B as the former super scrambles backward into the dark!
We have him cornered in 5B, Maya! Where is the crawlspace key?!
Check the hem of the yellow coat he dropped—and watch his hands, he's still clutching a second phone!
Tell your cops to back off or she runs out of air! You'll NEVER find the hidden latch in time!
DON'T TOUCH THE 3RD TILE BEHIND THE 5B BATHROOM MIRROR—COPS ARE HERE, RUN!
WAIT—he panicked and sent that to the wrong chat before unsending! Third tile behind the 5B bathroom mirror!!

nodes.transcript: [metallic click, gasping breath] Got it! Suspect is cuffed and the hidden panel just popped open—she's alive! Medics up here now!

nodes.text: Suspect is finally in cuffs. He was trying to warn an accomplice—you caught his slip in half a second, Maya!

nodes.prompt: Officers escort him past you in cuffs. Choose your Season Finale!

options.label: Hand his burner phone to Detective Morales
options.player_reply_text: Every text, photo, and voice note is on here. Lock him away for life.

options.label: Play his confession over the building intercom
options.player_reply_text: Every tenant in this building deserves to hear your voice one last time.

nodes.text: That burner phone just sealed twenty-five years without parole. You saved two lives tonight, Maya.
VIP FINALE: His recorded confession echoes through all six floors—residents cheer as the squad car pulls away!
The girl from 5B asked me to tell you thank you. She's going to make a full recovery.
I'm changing the locks at sunrise—and I'm never answering a 3 AM text again.

nodes.headline: He Did Not Build It Alone...
nodes.teaser_text: Act 2 · Episode 7: As sunrise hits Floor 4, a second hidden shaft blueprint proves the real predator is still inside the building.

nodes.text: 9:40 AM · Morning light fills Apt 4B. While packing your boxes, a folded blueprint slips out of the 5B crawlspace evidence envelope.
Detective Morales, did you see this? There are hidden maintenance shafts behind EVERY apartment on Floors 2 through 6.

nodes.caption: Municipal Permit #1998-4B · Unlisted vertical service shaft connecting Apt 4B, 5B, and Sub-Basement B2.

nodes.text: Hand that blueprint straight to me, Maya. Do not show the building tenants—it could jeopardize our ongoing investigation.
Wait... why does your email footer list a private security LLC instead of the city precinct?

nodes.prompt: Morales is already walking up the lobby steps. What do you do?

options.label: Photograph the blueprint & stall him
options.player_reply_text: Sure, Detective—give me ten minutes to lock my suitcase.

options.label: Call the precinct desk to verify his badge

nodes.text: Good. Stay inside 4B until I knock. Nobody else needs to know about Sub-Basement B2.
SECRET UNLOCKED: The 4th Precinct desk sergeant checks the roster twice—"We have NO Detective Morales on active duty!"
Hold on... if Morales isn't a real detective, then WHO took Noah's burner phone last night?!
I'm outside the elevator, Maya. Open up—we need to talk about that permit.

nodes.headline: No Detective By That Name...
nodes.teaser_text: Episode 8: The man who "saved" you at 3:33 AM is riding up to Floor 4—and his badge is fake.

nodes.text: 2:15 PM · Afternoon rain lashes the glass. You slipped out the fire stairs to a coffee shop across the street.
I called the 4th Precinct. There is no Detective Morales. Who the hell are you?
A flat, ice-cold voice answers: "Smart girl. You weren't supposed to look past the former super. Come back to the garage alone."
You decline. Instantly, a voicemail transcription lands: "Smart girl. You weren't supposed to dig past the super. Meet me in B1."
Don't make a scene in public, Maya. The men who own your building have friends at City Hall.

nodes.prompt: A black sedan slows down outside the café window. React!

options.label: Duck into the back alley & lose them
options.player_reply_text: Keep your sedan. I'm taking this blueprint straight to the FBI.

options.label: Zoom in & record the sedan's license plate

nodes.text: Run all you want. Your lease, your ID, and your spare key are already in my file.
SECRET UNLOCKED: The plate belongs to Vantage Holdings—the shell company that bought your apartment building in 2021!
You're the landlord's fixer! You used Noah as a scapegoat so the real cops would stop searching the building!
Shut down Floor 4 cameras tonight—the tenant in 4B knows about B2.

nodes.headline: He Deleted The Order Too Late...
nodes.teaser_text: Episode 9: A smuggled message arrives from county jail—and the man you put behind bars has a warning.

nodes.text: 6:30 PM · Dusk settles over the rain-slicked avenue. Your phone buzzes from a contact you swore was dead.
Maya, don't block me. My public defender let me send one text. You're in way more danger than last night.
Noah?! You stalked me through my air vents and trapped a girl in 5B! Why would I read a single word from you?
I messed up—I kept her hidden because she saw them installing cameras in B2! Morales isn't a cop. He's Vance's cleaner.

nodes.transcript: [muffled jail payphone] Listen to me! I was fired in 2023 because I refused to wire micro-cams into the ceiling smoke detectors. Check your own bedroom ceiling, Maya!

nodes.prompt: Could the former super be telling the truth about the cameras?

options.label: Demand proof of the B2 server room
options.player_reply_text: Prove it. Send me one photo from inside B2 right now.

options.label: Ask who the VIP buyers are
options.player_reply_text: Who is paying Vantage Holdings to spy on tenants?

nodes.text: I hid a cloud link inside my old maintenance log—sending you the last frame I grabbed before they fired me.
SECRET UNLOCKED: Noah whispers that Vantage runs an invite-only live stream for billionaire voyeurs—and Floor 4 was their crown jewel!
My God... that's why the previous three tenants in 4B "broke their leases" overnight.
Check your front hallway, Maya. Your mail slot just clicked.

nodes.headline: The Smoke Detector Blinks Red...
nodes.teaser_text: Episode 10: Noah's hidden photo loads—revealing the dark room right beneath your feet.

nodes.text: 7:05 PM · You slip back into Apt 4B through the service stairs and unscrew the bedroom smoke detector. A hairline glass lens stares back.
There's a fiber-optic camera wired straight into my ceiling! Noah wasn't lying!

nodes.caption: Sub-Basement B2 Feed · Two silhouettes monitoring 24 live apartment screens in pitch darkness.

nodes.text: That's Morales on the left. The man on the right owns the building. If they wipe those drives tonight, nobody will ever believe you.
Wait—they're watching me hold the smoke detector right now, aren't they?

nodes.prompt: The tiny red LED inside the lens just flickered. Move fast!

options.label: Tape over the lens & pack a go-bag
options.player_reply_text: Show's over. I'm taking the micro-cam straight to the press.

options.label: Leave the lens facing a fake decoy note

nodes.text: Smart—but don't use the lobby doors. Morales has two guards watching the street.
SECRET UNLOCKED: You aim the lens at a note reading "POLICE ALREADY HAVE B2"—and hear boots sprinting downstairs in panic!
Clever trick, Maya. Too bad the real police won't get a warrant before our midnight server purge.
Then I'll just have to reach Sub-Basement B2 before midnight myself.

nodes.headline: Four Hours Until The Wipe...
nodes.teaser_text: Episode 11: The rescued girl from 5B remembers where the janitor hid the spare RFID card.

nodes.text: 9:10 PM · Rain hammers the fire escape. You meet the rescued 5B tenant at the hospital café—and she hands you a crumpled list of names.
Maya, did she give you the ledger? Those four names were the tenants who lived in 4B before you.

nodes.transcript: [urgent whisper] Every time a tenant spotted the ceiling lens, Morales staged a "gas leak" or a "break-in" to force them out—or worse.

nodes.text: He was never trying to rescue her in 5B. He was trying to bury her before she talked!
Disable the lobby badge reader at 22:30. Nobody leaves Floor 4 tonight.

nodes.prompt: Morales just unsent an order to lock the building down at 10:30 PM!

options.label: Head back before the lobby locks
options.player_reply_text: I'm sneaking into the super's office before 10:30.

options.label: Send the tenant list to a crime reporter
options.player_reply_text: I just emailed the vanished tenant list to Channel 7.

nodes.text: Look behind the breaker panel in the ground-floor office. My old RFID keycard is taped under the metal lip.
SECRET UNLOCKED: The Channel 7 producer replies instantly—"Get us one hard drive from B2 and we go live at dawn!"
You missed your chance to walk away, Maya. Stay out of my building.
I'm already inside your ground-floor office. And I found what I was looking for.

nodes.headline: Access Granted: Sub-Basement B2
nodes.teaser_text: Episode 12: One black RFID card unlocks the hidden floor that isn't even on the elevator panel.

nodes.text: 10:40 PM · The ground-floor office smells of damp concrete. Your fingers close around a cold matte-black RFID card behind the breaker box.
Got it! It says SUB-B2 SERVER in silver ink. How do I get the elevator to go below the garage?

nodes.caption: Recovered RFID Keycard · Clearance Level: SUB-B2 SERVER ROOM — Authorized Maintenance Only.

nodes.text: Hold the Close-Door button and swipe the card twice while passing Floor 1. Do NOT let anyone see you step in.
Copy that. The lobby is dead silent—only the buzz of the fluorescent tube.

nodes.prompt: The elevator chimes at the lobby. Footsteps echo from the garage ramp!

options.label: Slip inside & swipe for B2 immediately
options.player_reply_text: Doors closing—swiping the card now.

options.label: Jam the stairwell door with a mop handle first

nodes.text: Good—once you're in B2, grab the red SSD labeled ARCHIVE-04. That holds every buyer's wire transfer.
SECRET UNLOCKED: Wedging the stairwell door buys you five extra minutes—and you spot Morales's key fob dropped by the vending machine!
Lobby motion sensor just tripped. I know you're in the elevator, Maya.
Wait... the elevator stopped between floors and the lights just died!

nodes.headline: Trapped In The Shaft...
nodes.teaser_text: Episode 13: Your phone rings in the pitch-black elevator—and the voice on the line sounds impossibly familiar.

nodes.text: 11:30 PM · Emergency amber lights flicker inside the stalled elevator cab. Your phone vibrates against your palm.
Noah, the cab is frozen between Floor 1 and B1! Are you still on the line?
Noah's voice speaks—too smooth, glitching on the consonants: "Maya, hit the emergency stop and climb out to B1. I'll catch you."
You decline. An AI-stitched audio message arrives in Noah's voice: "Climb out to B1 right now, Maya—it's safe."
WAIT!! THAT WASN'T ME! I'm still locked in county jail—he cloned my voice from the B2 recordings!

nodes.prompt: The cab jolts downward toward B2. What's your move?

options.label: Brace behind the steel side panel
options.player_reply_text: Nice try with the AI voice, Morales. I'm not walking into B1.

options.label: Trigger the roof hatch & drop onto B2 silently

nodes.text: You always spoil the fun, Maya. Fine—let's settle this in B2.
SECRET UNLOCKED: Dropping from the maintenance hatch lets you bypass the lobby camera—you land right behind the humming server racks!
I'm in Sub-Basement B2. There are twenty-four monitors glowing in the dark...
A heavy steel door clicks shut behind you. The air tastes like ozone and wet rust.

nodes.headline: Welcome To Sub-Basement B2
nodes.teaser_text: Episode 14: You find the red Archive SSD—just as Morales steps out from behind the server wall.

nodes.text: 12:12 AM · Blue LEDs blink across three tall server towers. Every apartment on Floor 4 is streaming live on the central screen.
I found the red SSD! It's hot to the touch—and there's an active upload bar labeled PURGE: 02:59.
Step away from the console, Maya. You have no idea how much money is wired into those racks.

nodes.transcript: [boots crunching on concrete] Put the drive on the desk and I'll let you move out of this city alive. Refuse, and Apt 4B gets a new tenant next week.

nodes.text: Don't hand it over! Pull the blue cooling hose on Rack 3—it trips the automatic halon alarm and unlocks the fire exit!

nodes.prompt: Morales rounds the corner of Rack 2 holding a heavy crowbar!

options.label: Yank the cooling hose & sprint for the exit
options.player_reply_text: Enjoy the fire alarm, Morales—I'm taking the drive!

options.label: Kill the main breaker & vanish into the dark

nodes.text: Red strobes explode across B2! The magnetic fire door pops open and I'm through!
SECRET UNLOCKED: Plunging B2 into total blackout blinds him—you snatch both the red SSD AND his master key fob off the desk!
LOCKDOWN INITIATED. Every exterior door in this building just bolted shut, Maya!
Heavy deadbolts slam across the ground floor. You're trapped inside a six-story cage with the syndicate's cleaner.

nodes.headline: Act 3: The Building Locks Down
nodes.teaser_text: Episode 15: 2:15 AM — Zero exits, one bar of signal, and 44 minutes before the syndicate erases everything.

nodes.text: 2:15 AM · Emergency red strips light the stairwell. You crouch behind the 3rd-floor laundry vents clutching the stolen red SSD.
You can't get out the lobby, and the fire doors are welded to my smart-relay. Give me the drive, Maya.
You locked twenty innocent families inside this building! The second they wake up, you're finished!
Maya, check the SSD port! If you plug it into your apartment router, you can push the client list straight to the real police server!
Sweep Floors 2 and 3 first—if she reaches her 4B router, we're all going to prison.

nodes.prompt: Heavy footsteps echo up the stairs from Floor 2. Act fast!

options.label: Climb the service shaft back to Floor 4
options.player_reply_text: I'm heading up to 4B—keep the real cops on the line!

options.label: Trip the 3rd-floor hallway sprinkler to slow him

nodes.text: My hands are shaking, but I'm inside the narrow shaft heading up to 4B.
SECRET UNLOCKED: Freezing water drenches the 3rd-floor landing, shorting out Morales's radio—buying you precious minutes!
I hear you scraping inside the wall, Maya. That shaft only opens into one room.
My phone signal just dropped to one bar... I have to reach the window before it dies!

nodes.headline: One Bar Of Signal Left...
nodes.teaser_text: Episode 16: Real tactical units are four blocks away—if your GPS ping reaches them before he cuts the roof antenna.

nodes.text: 2:34 AM · You tumble out of the closet vent back into Apt 4B and press your phone against the rain-streaked windowpane.
GPS lock is back! I just pinned the real 4th Precinct tactical unit—they're four blocks south!

nodes.caption: Live Emergency Dispatch GPS · Patrol Units 41 & 44 approaching Oakridge Ave — ETA 12 minutes.

nodes.text: Twelve minutes is an eternity if he cuts the building Wi-Fi! Plug the SSD into your router NOW!

nodes.transcript: [metallic clank outside] Did you really think I wouldn't cut the roof fiber line? Wait... why is your router still blinking green?

nodes.prompt: The upload bar crawls at 18%. Morales is on Floor 4!

options.label: Switch to cellular hotspot tethering
options.player_reply_text: Hotspot active—upload jumped to 45%!

options.label: Mirror the upload to the Channel 7 newsroom

nodes.text: Keep climbing—52%, 60%... just hold the deadbolt for six more minutes!
SECRET UNLOCKED: Channel 7's overnight producer confirms receipt of the first 20 VIP buyer invoices—police dispatch upgrades to Code 3!
Three slow knocks rattle your front door. Just like last night.
He's right outside Apt 4B... and he's wearing my yellow raincoat again.

nodes.headline: Three Slow Knocks At 2:47 AM
nodes.teaser_text: Episode 17: History repeats itself outside Apt 4B—only this time, you know exactly who is behind the door.

nodes.text: 2:47 AM · Three deliberate knocks echo down the dark hallway. Your deadbolt shudders under a master key.
Upload is at 74%! The chain lock is the only thing keeping him out!
Morales laughs softly through the door: "Open up, Maya. Hand me the red drive and I'll walk away before those sirens get here."
You decline. A crowbar scrapes loudly against the wooden doorframe—splinters drop onto the welcome mat.
One more pull and that chain snaps. Stop the upload right now!

nodes.prompt: The chain screws groan! You need 90 more seconds!

options.label: Wedge the oak dining table under the knob
options.player_reply_text: You're not getting this drive, Morales!

options.label: Stream his face live through the peephole

nodes.text: The table legs dig into the floorboards—holding him back while the upload hits 83%!
SECRET UNLOCKED: Your peephole livestream hits 4,000 viewers in thirty seconds—exposing the fake detective's face to the entire city!
Maya! Look out your window—real blue lights just turned onto Oakridge Avenue!
Forget the door—I'm coming through the bathroom vent!

nodes.headline: 88% Uploaded — Vent Screeches Open
nodes.teaser_text: Episode 18: The final broadcast begins as real sirens surround the building.

nodes.text: 2:54 AM · Blue and red lights paint your ceiling through the rain. The upload bar pulses at 89% as metal groans in the bathroom.
Real officers are breaching the lobby doors! Stand down or they'll catch you red-handed!
If I destroy that router before 100%, Vantage's lawyers will bury this by sunrise!

nodes.transcript: [shouting over sirens] Attention Oakridge Apartments! Check your phones—every tenant just received the B2 surveillance map!

nodes.text: 94%!! Hold on, Maya—officers just cleared Floor 2!

nodes.prompt: Morales kicks the bathroom door open and lunges for the router!

options.label: Unplug the phone & sprint for the balcony
options.player_reply_text: Too late—the hotspot is in my pocket!

options.label: Blind him with your phone strobe & slam the door

nodes.text: Get back here! Give me that phone before it finishes!
SECRET UNLOCKED: The blinding flash sends him stumbling over the overturned chair—buying the final five seconds!
98%... 99%... UPLOAD COMPLETE! Every buyer, every wire, every camera log is live with the FBI!
The front door hinges groan as a tactical battering ram hits the hallway.

nodes.headline: 2:59 AM — One Minute To Reckoning
nodes.teaser_text: Episode 19: The door flies open at 2:59 AM—and this time, the monster has nowhere left to run.

nodes.text: 2:59 AM · CRASH! Tactical officers flood Apt 4B with blinding flashlights, weapons raised.
Drop the crowbar? No—she stole private property from Vantage Holdings! I'm head of security!
Check your squad tablet, Officer! I just uploaded 24 live spy-cam feeds and his fake detective recordings!
I'm signing a full sworn statement from jail, Maya—tell them to pull the B2 server before Vantage sends lawyers!
The real Sergeant glances at his tablet—his expression turns stone cold as the live B2 footage plays.

nodes.prompt: Officers move in to cuff Morales. Deliver the final blow!

options.label: Hand over the red SSD directly to the Sergeant
options.player_reply_text: Here is the master drive—every VIP client is on it.

options.label: Play Morales's AI voice-clone call on speaker

nodes.text: You ruined everything, Maya! Vantage will tear this whole block down!
SECRET UNLOCKED: His own recorded threat echoes across the hallway—adding federal wiretap and kidnapping conspiracy charges on the spot!
It's 3:02 AM, Morales. And you're the one leaving in handcuffs.
As officers escort the fake detective down the stairwell, rain finally softens against the glass.

nodes.headline: Dawn Breaks Over Oakridge...
nodes.teaser_text: Episode 20 (Grand Finale): Morning sunlight returns—and you close the door on Apt 4B forever.

nodes.text: 8:15 AM · Clear morning sunlight warms the street outside Oakridge Apartments. Crime-scene tape seals Sub-Basement B2.
Every news channel is running the Vantage Holdings raid. The landlord and six VIP clients were arrested at dawn.
My lawyer says my sentence was cut for testifying about B2. I'm sorry I ever terrified you, Maya. Stay safe.
You still owe the girl from 5B a lifetime of apologies. But thank you for telling me about the ceiling cam.
You set the brass keys to Apt 4B on the moving truck dashboard and take a deep, quiet breath.

nodes.prompt: Your new sunlit apartment is waiting across town. Choose your Grand Finale!

options.label: Delete the old chat & drive into the sunrise
options.player_reply_text: Goodbye, Apt 4B. Never looking back.

options.label: Meet the 5B survivor for coffee first

nodes.text: You swipe "Delete Thread" and pull onto the sunlit boulevard, leaving the dark hallway behind forever.
VIP FINALE: Over warm lattes, the 5B survivor hugs you tight—"You didn't just save me, Maya. You saved every tenant in that building."
New lease signed. Ground floor, no air vents, and a steel deadbolt only I hold the key to.
Your phone chimes once with a cheerful welcome text from your new roommate. At 3:00 AM tonight, the hallway will stay silent.

nodes.headline: The Door Is Closed Forever.
nodes.teaser_text: Grand Finale Complete · You exposed the Vantage surveillance ring, survived the 3 AM siege, and reclaimed your peace.
